_provenance.upstream_operation: sigVer (external interface, preHash groups, upstream testPassed + reason)
_provenance.local_operation: HashSLH-DSA SigVer via PKCS#11 C_VerifyInit/C_Verify with CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> and CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT (upstream context). Positive cases must return CKR_OK; modified-message / modified-signature negatives CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID; too-small and too-large signatures CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE (PKCS#11 v3.2 section 5.1.6: the signature is invalid solely on the basis of its length). The same tuples also drive the message-based C_MessageVerifyInit/C_VerifyMessage pair.
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file (hex case preserved); no value is re-derived and no tcId or tgId is renumbered
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic and size-budgeted. The two cheapest parameter sets (SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s and SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128s, 7856-byte signatures) contribute their WHOLE external/preHash sigVer group minus the cases whose hashAlg has no PKCS#11 mechanism - 12 cases each, keeping the upstream testPassed and reason verbatim. Between them they carry all six upstream negative reasons (modified message; modified signature - R / SIGHT / SIGFORS; invalid signature - too small / too large) in both hash families. The other ten parameter sets' preHash sigVer groups are listed in notExecuted with why=subset-size-budget (their signatures run 16 KB to 50 KB each; their positive-polarity verify coverage comes from verifying the upstream signatures carried by slhdsa_prehash_siggen_<family>_test.json). Cases whose hashAlg has no CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256) and the internal-interface and external/pure groups are listed in notExecuted as metadata only. One file per SLH-DSA hash family.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, testPassed, reason, hashAlg, pk, message, context, signature (sk, additionalRandomness and deferred dropped)
